title: Grow Lancer joins MU Zylo
text: The Season 12 lance-and-shield class is here with Mirage and Shining Lancer evolutions. Reach level 250 on any character to unlock it.

title: Raid difficulties: Normal, Hard, Extreme
text: Both raids, the Sunken Citadel and the Tempest Spire, now scale up. Harder runs mean better chest odds. Clear times are tracked in the Hall of Fame.

title: Thanatos, the world boss
text: Deal the most damage to rank in the top 10 and earn experience buffs and Credits. The leaderboard is public.
